user.title: Add Cradlewise
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant should reach your crib. Automatic prefers your local network and falls back to Cradlewise cloud.

account_automatic.title: Cradlewise account
account_automatic.description: Your account is used to discover the crib and provision its device certificate. Automatic mode retains the email and password in Home Assistant's standard config-entry storage for cloud fallback. The integration does not add at-rest encryption.

account_local.title: Cradlewise account
account_local.description: Your account is used to discover the crib and provision its device certificate. Local-only mode discards the email and password after setup, but retains the provisioned device private key in Home Assistant's standard config-entry storage.

account_cloud.title: Cradlewise account
account_cloud.description: Your account is used to discover the crib and provision its device certificate. Cloud-only mode retains the email and password in Home Assistant's standard config-entry storage. The integration does not add at-rest encryption.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Cradlewise
reconfigure.description: Change connection mode or local address without replacing the crib or its entities. Leave the password blank to keep it. Automatic can discover a blank local address. Any mode with local access revalidates the broker and trusts its current core CA.

media.title: Optional media companion
media.description: Add the separate media companion for live video, or leave the URL blank to use Home Assistant without video. HTTPS is required unless the address resolves only to a trusted private network and you explicitly accept unencrypted HTTP.

data.allow_insecure_http: Allow unencrypted HTTP on my trusted private network

data_description.bridge_status_url: The HTTPS base address of the companion, or an HTTP address restricted to your private network.
data_description.bearer_token: Leave blank to keep the stored token.
data_description.allow_insecure_http: HTTP exposes the bearer token and video snapshots to devices that can observe traffic on that network.

remove_registration.title: Remove cloud registration and integration
remove_registration.description: This permanently removes Cradlewise device registration `{device_id}` and then deletes this Home Assistant integration entry. Its entities will disappear. Apple Home names, rooms, favorites, automations, and scenes tied to them may be lost. The crib itself is not unpaired. Credentials entered here are used only for removal and are not newly stored.

data.confirm_registration_removal: I understand and want to permanently remove this registration and integration

error.cannot_connect_local: The new certificate was provisioned, but the local crib broker could not be verified. The new registration was removed and the existing configuration was kept.
error.invalid_certificate: Cradlewise returned a certificate that is not currently valid
error.wrong_cradle: This account does not contain the configured crib

reprovision.title: Reprovision Cradlewise certificate
reprovision.description: The stored device certificate is missing, malformed, expired, not valid yet, or nearing expiration. Authenticate to create a replacement without changing the Home Assistant config entry, entity IDs, or device identity. Automatic and cloud-only modes retain the submitted email and password. Local-only mode discards them after repair. Optionally remove the previous cloud registration only after the replacement has been validated.

data.remove_old_registration: Remove the previous cloud device registration after successful repair
